thread:
Elena: Quick request — lightweight "StatKit" for the May 5 webinar. Deliverables: 1 wide hero stat image (for slide + social), 3 social crops, 1 GIF micro-animation, and a single-slide PDF explainer for sales. Can design take it?
Marcus: We can pick this up. What's the priority stat to lead with?
Elena: Lead with: median latency 58ms, p99 180ms, inference cost $0.065/1k tokens. Callouts: 'predictable economics' and 'unified runtime'. Keep hero headline under 9 words.
Hannah: Legal constraints: no absolutes. Replace "cheapest"/"fastest" w/ "industry-leading" or omit. Any metric claims must include source CSV in the asset package with footnote: "See benchmark data".
Design-bot: New Figma file created by Marcus: "StatKit-May05" https://figma.com/file/statkit-may05 node=9
Marcus: Visual direction idea: left-aligned stat block, small trend sparkline, and icon row (latency, cost, throughput). No drop shadows, core palette only. GIF: subtle count-up to median stat, 3s loop.
Elena: CTA link: https://redwood.ai/webinar-may05?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=statkit_may05. UTM param for inbound mapping: source=statkit_may05.
Hannah: Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast, provide alt text for each export, and separate text layers for localization.
Marcus: Export sizes requested: 1200x675 (wide), 1080x1080 (square), 800x420 (GIF), and PPTX/PDF. Also need a one-slide editable PPTX for sales.
Elena: Copy variants (short):
```
Variant 1: Predictable inference. Median latency 58ms. Register May 5.
Variant 2: Ship LLM features with consistent latency and clear economics. Live demo May 5.
Variant 3: See inference that scales — stable latency, transparent cost. Join May 5.
```
Marcus: Timeline: first drafts by Tue noon, GIF prototype by Wed, final assets by Thu EOD for Legal and Localization. I'll drop drafts in Figma and tag folks.
Hannah: I'll review metric phrasing once mock is in Figma. If we need additional substantiation RD, can you confirm the CSV link?
RD: Confirmed  uploading CSV + benchmark notes to the asset folder now: https://drive.redwood/marketing/statkit_may05.csv
Elena: Ops/inbound: map source=statkit_may05, route to queue bench-webinar; APAC -> apac-sdr. Hidden field: stat_variant.
Marcus: Accessibility checklist posted in Figma comments. Also adding a manifest CSV with alt text and export filenames.
Hannah: Legal ok to proceed pending final footnote wording. Suggest footnote copy: "Benchmark compares Redwood Dedicated runtime to baseline; see data."
Elena: Great. Schedule social posts May 6 10:00 PT. Marcus, please upload final exports to /marketing-assets/statkit_may05 after approvals. Thanks team :rocket:
Marcus: Will do. Tagging @Hannah and @RD for final sign-off when ready.
